t: For the purposes of this Act, the term “Diamond Fork System” means the facilities described in chapter 4 of the October 2004 Supplement to the 1988 Definite Plan Report for the Bonneville Unit.

fable.w: This section only defines the term "Diamond Fork System" by reference to a prior planning document. The tempting reading is that the cited Definite Plan Report implies some planning process with outside input, but that is a reference to an existing document, not a requirement for future consultation, comment, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision here.
fable.s: the term “Diamond Fork System” means the facilities described in chapter 4 of the October 2004 Supplement to the 1988 Definite Plan Report for the Bonneville Unit
